texts.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描显示这是一颗死亡行星，它曾经是气态巨行星，但大气层被[from.System.Star.GetName]强烈的辐射剥离了。

尽管如此，它的地表上还是探测到了非常痕量的生物质，需要进一步调查。
texts.en:
Surveys of [from.GetName] reveal it to be a chthonian planet, a former gas giant stripped of its atmosphere by the intense radiation of [from.System.Star.GetName].

Despite this, very faint traces of biomass have been detected on its surface, warranting further investigation.

sections.zh:
对[from.GetName]的扫描显示这是一颗死亡行星，它曾经是气态巨行星，但大气层被[from.System.Star.GetName]强烈的辐射剥离了。

尽管如此，它的地表上还是探测到了非常痕量的生物质，需要进一步调查。
sections.en:
Surveys of [from.GetName] reveal it to be a chthonian planet, a former gas giant stripped of its atmosphere by the intense radiation of [from.System.Star.GetName].

Despite this, very faint traces of biomass have been detected on its surface, warranting further investigation.

texts.zh:
[from.GetName]上的生物质信号竟然是来自一小群缇扬奇。

它们可能是在这颗气态巨行星的大气消散前的一个临界点到来的，随后被熔融金属包裹着凝固了。

虽然有少量的生物物质留存，但在长期暴露在炼狱级的恒星辐射下，它们的大部身体已经变成了一种独特的生物金属合金。

[leader.GetName]相信，对这些珍惜的化石进行更细致的研究我们可以发现一种以生物原材料生产合金的新方法。
texts.en:
The biomass readings on [from.GetName] are the petrified remains of a pod of Tiyanki.

Likely present in the gas giant during a critical point in its atmospheric dissipation, their bodies were encased in molten metal that has since solidified.

While a small amount of biological matter remains inside, prolonged exposure to the chthonian-level stellar radiation has converted the majority of their corpses into a unique bio-metallic alloy.

[leader.GetName] believes that with closer study of these rare fossils, we will be able to discover new avenues of alloy production from biological sources.

texts.zh: 我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]们通过研究[from.GetName]上缇扬奇兽群的化石遗骸，旨在完全理解炼狱级核辐射对生物质的影响，并有可能发现全新的高级合金生产方式。
texts.en: By examining the petrified remains of the fossilized Tiyanki pod on [from.GetName], our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] aim to fully understand the effects of chthonian-level radiation on biological matter, potentially opening up new means of advanced alloy production.

texts.zh:
在对[from.From.GetName]上化石化的缇扬奇遗骸进行细致的调查后，我们研究出了一种模拟这种长时间炼狱级辐射暴露效应的新的合金产出方式。

这一突破性发现带来了一种杰出的制造方式，它使用生物质作为主要原料，而产出却可以与传统的方法相媲美。
texts.en:
Following careful examinations of the petrified Tiyanki remains on [from.From.GetName], we have successfully identified a new means of alloy production by simulating the effects of long-term chthonian-level radiation exposure.

This breakthrough offers a remarkable methodology which uses biological matter as its primary raw material, producing results that rival more conventional methods.
